name: resolvetrace
description: Open-source accountability infrastructure built on Stellar and Soroban

scripts.build:packages: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/storage/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:cli && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
